title: [CLM-2] Relay-side push registrations and `pushUrgency` are outside the observation budget
description: Review finding CLM-2: Relay-side push registrations and `pushUrgency` are outside the observation budget (lens CLM). Location: spec/11-transport.md:160, 194, 233-238; spec/12-security.md:48; ARCHITECTURE.md:161, 286-288; PRFAQ.md:31. Fix: The registration half follows from decision Q4 ("push on by default"; ARCHITECTURE §8 Q4 "Push is in the §5 budget by default"): S6 forbids observing anything outside §5, and the relay necessarily holds `channelToken → pushHandle` (11-transport.md:160), yet §5 item 7 reads "For push proxies only". Extend item 7 to relays serving push (per-`pushHandle` token sets and proxy endpoint), add per-handle clustering to §9 next to address clustering, and add it to the PRFAQ relay-visibility answer. No decision needed for that part. `pushUrgency` is different: Q4 says "content-free wake-ups" and does not cover a sender-supplied DM/mention label, and 12.4 says a Relay "cannot distinguish them from other traffic by type". Keeping it means a budget extension and a 12.4 exception. Dropping it makes the 12.4 claim true. Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
